'''Petals''' are the main tools and weapons in [[florr.io]]. All players have access to five petal slots by default, and they can gain up to five additional petal slots (adding up to ten) with the [[Talents/Loadout|Loadout talent]]. Players also have an equal number of secondary petal slots. A petal in a secondary slot can be switched with a different petal in the primary slot directly above. There are currently '''118''' petals; however, [[M28]], the developer, is going to add more in the future. When colliding with [[Mobs|mobs]], flowers and other petals, they deal damage. Petals also receive damage from collisions, which lowers their health and subsequently the amount of damage they deal. When a petal's health is depleted, it will be destroyed temporarily and reappear after a certain amount of time (the petal's cooldown time). When swapping and equipping a new petal, the minimum reload time is 2.5 seconds. The minimum reload time can be decreased to 0 seconds by upgrading the [[Talents/Reload|Reload talent]]. This rule only applies when first equipping a petal to replace another, not when reloading the equipped petal. Petals with an original reload time of 2.5 seconds or more are unaffected by this rule. The "2.0s + 1.0s" cooldown time format means that the petal takes 2 seconds to reload, and 1 second after being reloaded to perform its special action (if it has one). If the minimum reload time is 2.5 seconds: *the petal will take 2.5 seconds (instead of 2.0 seconds) to spawn when it is first equipped, and will take 1.0 seconds to perform its special action (e.g., heal for [[Rose]]); and *when the petal is destroyed, it will go with the normal 2.0 seconds reload time until the petal is unequipped or swapped out. Players can switch petals by using the number keys. Each slot corresponds to a number based on its location with the number appearing below each slot. Pressing this number switches the active petal and the secondary petal. Petals can also be switched by clicking on either or the petals that the player would like to switch. Pressing R (or X on mobile) completely switches the inventory. Players can save their current assortment of petals to their desired loadout slots, which can be accessed by pressing K or L plus a number key from 0 to 9 (on PC) or holding X and then tapping on one of the secondary petal slots (on mobile). When switching between loadout slots, the icon of the leftmost petal in each loadout slot is shown. All petals obtained by the player during game play will have their icons saved in their [[Inventory]] and the [[Crafting|Crafting menu]]. All petals range in [[Rarity|rarity]], but players can craft higher rarity petals. Some petals do not have lower rarities (e.g., [[Antennae]] starts at {{R|3}} rarity, while [[Basil]] starts at {{R|6}} rarity). Petals are dropped by mobs once they die and shared in PvE, meaning everyone can pick the drops up if they do at least 15% damage to the mob and rank top 4 in terms of damage dealt. For {{R|8|Super+}} mobs, the thresholds are 1% and top 25 respectively. Most petals can be purchased from the [[Shop]]. Except for [[Rift]], it is impossible to steal drops from someone else, even in [[PvP]] where drops are not shared. Magic variants of certain normal petals (namely the [[Magic Petals|magic petals]]) can also be dropped by mobs when a [[Mana Orb]] is equipped. They may have improved stats and/or abilities compared to their base version, but they need [[Mana|mana]] to be spawned or even maintained. == Petal List ==

File:Orderized rarity petals new.png|Petals categorized Rarity and alphabetically from top (Super) to bottom (Common). ==Trivia== *Relic is for some reason not in this list. *Every rarity except eternal has a petal that starts only at this rarity e.g.: *{{R|1}}: [[Glass]] *{{R|2}}: [[Missile]] *{{R|3}}: [[Antennae]] *{{R|4}}: [[Mysterious Stick]] *{{R|5}}: [[Yggdrasil]] *{{R|6}}:[[Third Eye]] *{{R|7}}: [[Corruption]] *{{R|8}}:[[Blood Sacrifice]] *{{R|Unique}}: [[Pharaoh's Crown]] *Note that all of the petals above with a lower rarity than listed can not be gained by any legitimate means in the game. *A total of 118 petals can be currently found in the game. **30 of those petals are from legacy florr.io, while the other 88 were added ever since florr.io was revamped. However, the 30 legacy petals have some differences from their legacy states: ***The starting rarity of some petals may not match with their legacy rarity; ***Certain petals are missing, such as [https://florrio.fandom.com/wiki/Heavy Heavy]; ***The {{Rarity|Eternal}} and {{Rarity|Unique}} rarity is missing; ***[https://florrio.fandom.com/wiki/{{Rarity|Rare}} Rose], [https://florrio.fandom.com/wiki/Peas_(Epic) {{Rarity|Epic}}] and [https://florrio.fandom.com/wiki/Peas_(Legendary) {{Rarity|Legendary}} Peas], [https://florrio.fandom.com/wiki/Heaviest Heaviest] and [https://florrio.fandom.com/wiki/Fast Fast], [https://florrio.fandom.com/wiki/Twin Twin] and [https://florrio.fandom.com/wiki/Triplet Triplet] were renamed to, respectively: [[Dahlia]], [[Grapes]], [[Heavy]] and [[Light]]; ***Multiple rarity variants of a certain petal (such as [https://florrio.fandom.com/wiki/Cactus Cactus] and its [https://florrio.fandom.com/wiki/Cactus_(Epic) {{Rarity|Epic}} variant]) are now in the same lineage of petals (e.g. [[Cactus]]); ***Some petals are dropped by different mobs, and only of a certain rarity or above; ***[[Dandelion]] debuffs flowers by 20% for 15 seconds while stacking, and is not shootable anymore but goes farther away on offensive mode than most other petals, and receives one extra Dandelion at both the {{Rarity|Mythic}} and the {{Rarity|Ultra}} rarity variants; ***[[Heavy]] slows down petal rotation speed; ***[[Honey]] can be dropped to the ground, disappears after some time, attracts mobs to its location while it's on the ground, has a mob rarity limit and mobs can develop immunity to its attraction; ***[[Salt]] reflects 20% damage to flowers, 50% damage to mobs of the same rarity, (n*3) 50% damage to mobs of (n-1) rarity below it (whereas n is the number of the rarities the mob is below the petal, and 1 being the same rarity) and less damage to mobs above its own rarity; ***[[Stinger]] is now 3 petals in 1 at {{Rarity|Mythic}} rarity, and not {{Rarity|Legendary}}, and finally; ***[[Yin Yang]] changes the petal rotation orientation at 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 Yin Yangs in one build, while increasing the petal orbit layers at 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 Yin Yangs in one build (layers start at 1 with zero Yin Yangs, then 2 layers at 2, 3 at 4, 4 at 6, 5 at 8 and all 10 at 10). **There are 56 petals starting at the {{Rarity|Common}} rarity, 21 at the {{Rarity|Unusual}} rarity, 10 at the {{Rarity|Rare}} rarity, 2 at the {{Rarity|Epic}} rarity, 2 at the {{Rarity|Legendary}} rarity, 5 at the {{Rarity|Mythic}} rarity, and 5 at the {{Rarity|Ultra}} rarity. *Petals, while heavily influencing almost all of them, are directly the subject of 54 [[Achievements]]: **The "All-seeing" {{Rarity|Unusual}} Achievement, granted to you once you equip [[Antennae]] of any rarity; **The 2 "Be gone" Achievements of {{Rarity|Legendary}} and {{Rarity|Ultra}} rarities, granted to you once you mark, respectively, 1 player and 100 players with [[Dark Mark]]; **The "Breath in, breath out" {{Rarity|Epic}} secret Achievement, granted to you once you rapidly equip and unequip [[Air]] of any rarity multiple times; **The "Collector" {{Rarity|Super}} Achievement, granted to you once you grab 65 different petal drops in one playthrough, which means without dying; **The 4 "Consolation prize" Achievements of the {{Rarity|Common}}, {{Rarity|Ultra}}, {{Rarity|Super}} and {{Rarity|Eternal}} rarities, granted to you once you lose, respectively, 4 petals of any rarity, 4 {{Rarity|Mythic}} petals, 4 {{Rarity|Ultra}} petals and 4 {{Rarity|Super}} petals from a fail in [[Crafting]]; **The 7 "Crafter" Achievements of all rarities starting at {{Rarity|Unusual}}, granted to you once you successfully craft a petal of the rarity corresponding to the Achievement's own from Crafting; **The "Digger" {{Rarity|Unusual}} Achievement, granted to you once you equip [[Cutter]] of any rarity; **The 3 "Evasive" Achievements of the {{Rarity|Rare}}, {{Rarity|Legendary}} and {{Rarity|Ultra}} rarities, granted to you once you evade, respectively, 1k, 100k and 10m damage values with [[Talisman of Evasion]]; **The "Gambler" {{Rarity|Legendary}} Achievement, granted to you once you insert 1000 [[Poker Chip|Chips]] of any rarity at [[Plinko]]; **The 7 "Gear Up" Achievements of all rarities starting at {{Rarity|Unusual}}, granted to you once you equip, respectively, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 10 petals of the same rarity in one build (the rarity of the petal depends on the Achievement); **The "Go to WHERE?" {{Rarity|Unusual}} Achievement, granted to you once you get marked and successfully sent to [[Hel]] by a [[Mark]] from another player; **The "High roller" {{Rarity|Super}} Achievement, granted to you once you insert an {{Rarity|Ultra}} or a {{Rarity|Super}} Chip in Plinko **The "High volume crafter" {{Rarity|Ultra}} Achievement, granted to you once you successfully craft, in all of your playthroughs, 200k petals of any rarity from Crafting; **The "JACKPOT!" {{Rarity|Mythic}} Achievement, granted to you once you hit the 500x Chip multiplier bucket in Plinko; **The "Magician" {{Rarity|Epic}} Achievement, granted to you once you equip a [[Mana Orb]] of any rarity; **The "Return to sender" {{Rarity|Rare}} Achievement, granted to you once you hit a mob with [[Jelly]]; **The "Rolling in dough" {{Rarity|Legendary}} Achievement, granted to you once you grab 100 petal drops from different [[mobs]] in one second or less; **The "Sacrifice" {{Rarity|Mythic}} Achievement, granted to you once you die one second (or less) after you revive someone with a Yggdrasil; **The "Saved" {{Rarity|Legendary}} Achievement, granted to you once a player revives you with [[Yggdrasil]]; **The 2 "Savior" Achievements of {{Rarity|Legendary}} and {{Rarity|Ultra}} rarities, granted to you once you revive, respectively, 1 player and 100 players with Yggdrasil; **The 2 "Sound barrier" Achievements of {{Rarity|Mythic}} and {{Rarity|Ultra}} rarities, granted to you once you move a lot of tiles in a very short amount of time, usually achieved with [[Bubble]]s or [[Rubber]]s; **The 4 "Summoner" Achievements of the {{Rarity|Rare}}, {{Rarity|Epic}}, {{Rarity|Legendary}} and {{Rarity|Mythic}} rarities, granted to you once you spawn, respectively, 1, 100, 1k and 10k friendly mobs; **The "Termites…?" {{Rarity|Rare}} Achievement, granted to you once you spawn a friendly [[Soldier Termite]] from using both [[Ant Egg]] and [[Relic]] in the same build; **The "The all-seeing one" and "It was destiny" Achievements of {{Rarity|Legendary}} and {{Rarity|Ultra}} rarities, which, despite having different names, share almost the same completion method as if they had the same name: they are granted to you once you, respectively, craft a petal of any rarity and an {{Rarity|Ultra}} Petal with [[Oracle]]; **The "The lucky one" {{Rarity|Legendary}} Achievement, granted to you once you craft 10 petals in a row without fail from Crafting; **The "The unlucky one" {{Rarity|Ultra}} Achievement, granted to you once you fail 100 petal crafts in a row without success from Crafting;
